description: Verify that DUT emits ARP Probes with Ethernet destination = broadcast (FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF) (RFC 3927 §2.2.1, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §2.2.1 mandates ARP Probes go out as link-layer broadcast — every host on the segment must see them so any address conflict can be detected. This case observes the first DUT-emitted Probe and asserts its Ethernet destination is the all-ones broadcast MAC.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf with the fast envelope. tc8-dut emits one DHCPDISCOVER (covering the spec precondition step 'DUT: Sends DHCPDISCOVER Message') then enters the PROBE phase.

2. Observation:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Probe (the first one)
     - Ethernet dst = FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF   ← key check

[Pass condition]
First DUT Probe carries Ethernet dst = FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_probe_not_broadcast — Probe Ethernet dst is not the broadcast MAC
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted Probe used Ethernet broadcast — normal
verdicts.Fail_probe_not_broadcast: DUT ARP Probe Ethernet destination is not broadcast
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline
